all_points.description: fit every sample instead of every second one

preceding_blank.description: double-reference with the preceding blank only

misfit_ratio_2.description: require the 1:1 residual RMS to exceed twice the complex model's

always_one_to_one.description: fit every analyte with 1:1 (avidity and heterogeneity ignored)

any_improvement.description: accept the complex model whenever it lowers the residual at all

apparent_kd.description: select models correctly but report the apparent 1:1 KD for bivalent analytes

format_blind.description: ignore analyte format and test only the heterogeneous-ligand alternative
edits:
alt = "bivalent_analyte" if mw >= IGG_MW else "heterogeneous_ligand"
        alt = "heterogeneous_ligand"
